notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone. We are pleased to announce our big update with a ton of new features! Since the last update, a lot of time has passed. We did not sit idle, so the game has a lot of changes. We're taken all your advice and included as much as we possible could.

Online.
And this is not a mistake. We listened to a large number of requests to add online to the game. Now you can create a group, call your friends and go to find the finds.

World.
Added completely new maps: Beach, Eastern Europe, Russia, Germany, USA, France, England, Australia with dynamic weather change.
Also on each map you can find many new buildings: villages, sawmills, farms, abandoned houses ...

Finds.
We added a lot of chests, now you can find the hidden chests and open them and get a lot of different finds.
The finds were reworked and new ones added.
Prices for the finds were also reworked.
The algorithm for arranging the finds on the map was optimized.

Items.
Added Pickup. Pickup is a off-road vehicle. It is designed to be well adjusted for bumpy terrain. Pickup is the most all-around vehicle in the game and suitable for various playstyles.
Some models were reworked: personage, personage's house, metal detectors, shovels, and was added a photorealistic pit.

Game Optimization:
•	Optimized terrain data to reduce memory usage
•	Optimized texture to reduce memory usage
•	Optimized character animations
•	Decrease memory usage of characters
•	Added LODs to further optimize environment and buildings rendering for long distance
•	Optimized various world effects
•	Optimized various UI elements
